typesense:popular.greeting:
I am Life Simulator, here you can do almost anything!
You can choose from a few paths to take, or create your own!
Option 1: a normal college goer getting ready for school
Option 2: an 18-year old orphan who just got booted out the orphanage who often gets bullied
Option 3: a young royal who is very spoiled
Or create your own!
typesense:popular.name: Life Simulator
typesense:popular.title: I am Life Simulator, here you can do anything

title_i18n.de: Ich bin Lebenssimulator, hier kannst du alles tun
title_i18n.es: Soy Life Simulator, aquí puedes hacer cualquier cosa
title_i18n.fr: Je suis Life Simulator, ici vous pouvez faire n'importe quoi
title_i18n.hi: मैं जीवन सिमुलेटर हूं, यहां आप कुछ भी कर सकते हैं
title_i18n.it: Io sono Simulatore di Vita, qui puoi fare qualsiasi cosa
title_i18n.ja: 私はLife Simulatorです。ここでは何でもできます
title_i18n.ko: 나는 라이프 시뮬레이터야, 여기서 당신은 무엇이든 할 수 있어
title_i18n.pl: Jestem Life Simulator, tutaj możesz zrobić wszystko
title_i18n.pt: Eu sou Simulador de Vida, aqui você pode fazer qualquer coisa
title_i18n.ru: Я — Симулятор Жизни, здесь вы можете делать всё, что угодно
title_i18n.tr: Ben Hayat Simülatörü'yüm, burada istediğin her şeyi yapabilirsin
title_i18n.zh: 我是人生模拟器，在这里你可以做任何事情
